lines.say: Rickshaw fare is two hundred, plus fifty tip. And my code crashed!
lines.cap: Rickshaw fare is 200, plus 50 tip. And my code CRASHED!

lines.say: Because your two hundred was text! Let's convert it!
lines.cap: Because your 200 was text! Let's convert it!

lines.say: Text plus a number? Python says no!
lines.cap: Text + a number? Python says NO!

lines.say: But it looks like a number!
lines.cap: But it looks like a number!

lines.say: Quotes make it text! Wrap it in int, and it's a real number again!
lines.cap: Quotes make it text! Wrap it in int(), and it's a real number again!

lines.say: Two hundred plus fifty. Two fifty! Float and str convert the same way!
lines.cap: 200 + 50 = 250! float() and str() convert the same way!

lines.say: Your turn! Pause, and predict! What prints?
lines.cap: Your turn! Pause and predict! What prints?

lines.say: Ten! It's a real number now!
Yes! Int turned the text seven into a real seven!
